faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 0 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: The News Roundup covers the Iran war, soaring prices, Venezuela oil deals, and midterm…
kurzfassung: The program examines the ongoing conflict with Iran and its heavy toll on global markets and American fuel prices. Guests analyze a controversial U.S.-led oil deal in Venezuela, mounting tensions with traditional allies, and preparations for the upcoming midterm elections. The discussion also addresses leadership shake-ups at the Pentagon, new jobs numbers, and international developments including devastating floods in Nepal.
stichpunkte: Intensified U.S. airstrikes against Iran enter their seventh month, driving diesel and gas prices to record highs.
A newly signed agreement grants a U.S.-led company control over 17 Venezuelan oil fields, though analysts doubt production can ramp up quickly.
Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigns amid persistent tensions with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
Global bond yields rise as European and Canadian leaders criticize U.S. economic policies at a G20 summit.
August job numbers show a rebound with 162,000 added jobs, while inflation and wages remain a central concern for voters.
A whistleblower warns that a new USPS mail-in voting system could create widespread chaos and disenfranchise voters ahead of the midterms.
The Supreme Court allows construction of the White House ballroom to continue, ruling that preservation groups lack standing.
Catastrophic flooding in Nepal leaves over 1,300 people dead and thousands missing following a glacial collapse.

clips.hook: Diesel prices hit an all-time record high
clips.text: Fuel costs reach unprecedented levels, with tracking data indicating that the summer and the upcoming holiday weekend are the most expensive on record for motorists.

clips.hook: Russian finance minister invited to G20 summit
clips.text: Traditional U.S. allies express deep frustration after Moscow's representative is welcomed to the economic summit while the war in Ukraine continues unabated.
An early supporter of the administration's immigration policies experiences arrest and removal firsthand, later describing the process as physically degrading.

clips.hook: Billions in U.S. taxpayer money lost on damaged radar
clips.text: Russian intelligence and satellite imagery assist Iranian forces in destroying expensive American radar installations in the region.

clips.hook: Eighty-five Americans missing in Nepal floods
clips.text: The immense scale of the Himalayan disaster becomes apparent as contributors note the high number of missing U.S. citizens amid hundreds of fatalities.

beschreibung:
Following months of a tenuous ceasefire and several rounds of failed negotiations, the U.S. and Iran traded military strikes this week threatening to once again plunge the surrounding region into conflict.

A whistleblower inside the United States Postal Service is warning that the agency is rushing to implement a system to deal with mail-in ballots that, due to its untested nature, could disenfranchise millions of voters in the U.S.

Months after the beginning of Immigration and Customs Enforcement operations in U.S. cities, and after several fatal shootings, ICE now says it has enough body cameras for its agents.

And, in global news, following renewed violence between Washington and Tehran, Russian President Vladimir Putin pledged support for Iran this week in its conflict with the U.S. and encouraged other world leaders to do the same.

The U.S. is working with interim President Delcy Rodriguez on a plan to take control of roughly one fifth of Venezuela’s oil supply.

And voters in Iceland struck down a referendum on restarting talks to join the European Union.

We cover the most important stories from around the world in the News Roundup.
